instances.composition_description: A chitosan-starch-like biopolymer host is implemented as chitosan, blended with PVA as film former, loaded with 1D attapulgite, and acidified with retained phosphoric acid.
expected_properties: cold_window: plausible bound-water and acid continuity across 182-299 K via OH-rich plasticised network.
nanoconfinement: 1D attapulgite should guide interconnected acid domains.
retention: chitosan-clay interactions may suppress phosphoric-acid loss.
risk_flags: low-temperature brittleness if PVA-rich and insufficiently plasticised.
acid leaching remains possible at excessive PA loading.
instances.novelty_rationale: The individual roles are supported, but this exact chitosan/PVA/attapulgite/PA cold-window blend is not directly present in the pool. It is a targeted quaternary synergy combining OH-rich host, film former, 1D confinement, and retained acid.

instances.composition_description: A starch/PVA blend is plasticised and protonated using a choline chloride-phosphoric acid deep eutectic to create a non-crystallising polar conduction phase.
expected_properties: cold_window: DES-like phase should better resist freezing than neat water-rich acid domains.
matrix_flexibility: starch/PVA hydrogen bonding can support coherent flexible films.
proton_relay: OH-rich matrix plus PA-containing DES should enable hybrid proton transfer.
risk_flags: excess DES may over-soften the membrane.
retention of acid-rich DES may be weaker without a nanoconfining filler.
instances.novelty_rationale: This combines a known OH-rich starch/PVA matrix with a ChCl/PA acid complexing phase not explicitly paired in the pool. The novelty is using the DES motif to extend bound polar-fluid continuity toward the 182-299 K window.

instances.composition_description: A chitosan scaffold is filled with halloysite nanotubes pre-associated with phosphoric acid to form confined proton-conducting channels.
expected_properties: nanoconfinement: HNT lumen/surface confinement should stabilize interconnected acid pathways.
retention: both chitosan and HNTs are supportive of reduced acid loss.
cold_window: confined acid domains are plausibly less prone to disruptive crystallisation than bulk acid-water phases.
risk_flags: conductivity may drop if acid loading is kept too low for retention.
instances.novelty_rationale: The pool supports chitosan as a retaining scaffold and HNTs as a PA-confiner, but not this exact ternary membrane. It is a plausible cold-side analogue of clay-confined acid systems with a biopolymer retention shell.

instances.composition_description: An amorphous protonated phosphate glass is used as the continuous proton-conducting phase without a separate liquid electrolyte.
expected_properties: pathway_continuity: amorphous network directly matches a no-freezing continuous transport medium.
proton_relay: phosphate OH environments support hydrogen-bond-assisted transfer.
retention: proton-conducting species are structurally embedded in the glass network.
risk_flags: mechanical brittleness may limit membrane integration.
long-term conductivity can depend on maintaining hydration/proton content.
instances.novelty_rationale: This is retained as a control because the claim pool already directly supports the archetype. It provides a non-polymeric benchmark for continuous proton transport without a freezing liquid phase.

instances.composition_description: A chitosan membrane is plasticised with an acid-containing deep eutectic environment and supplemented with phosphoric acid as the main proton donor.
expected_properties: bound_fluid: DES addition plausibly preserves mobile hydrogen-bonded polar domains near 200 K.
matrix_flexibility: DES-plasticised chitosan should resist brittle channel loss better than dry chitosan.
retention: chitosan can hold a high polar-phase fraction without disintegration.
risk_flags: separate added PA may increase leaching versus DES-only formulations.
too much plasticiser may weaken dimensional stability.
instances.novelty_rationale: The pool supports chitosan-DES films and PA as a proton carrier, but not an explicit chitosan/DES/PA ternary tuned for cold operation. The novelty is separating the plasticising non-crystallising carrier role from the main acid-loading role.
